messages:
mia - design: dropped a new revoke/disable modal variant + empty-keys screen in the figma link. quick eyeballs on copy + keyboard flow? https://figma.com/file/efgh5678

devon - eng: looks clean. one ask: we use two CTAs (Disable / Revoke). backend treats 'disable' as reversible (soft revoke). need the copy to make that explicit or we'll get support tickets.

sam - ux: agree. suggest short inline definitions under the title: "Disable: temporarily stop key (can re-enable)" and "Revoke: permanently invalidate". keep it one line each.

lucy - product: also add the undo window length for Disable. default 24h org override possible. ops-bot, confirm config?

ops-bot: config:keys.disable_grace default=86400s (24h). orgs with enterprise plan may set via org.settings.disable_grace_seconds. audit events emitted for disable/revoke.

raj - eng: accessibility: modal should use role=alertdialog for both flows because they’re destructive. ensure focus trap and Escape closes only when not in a form state. current prototype closes on Escape even with unsaved reason.

sam - ux: +1. also tooltip on the action explaining required permission: "Requires key.manage or key.admin; request access" with an inline request link. make sure tooltip is keyboard-accessible.

mia - design: noted. color-wise the revoke pill is red but low contrast on hover. I'll update colors and run a contrast check. any preference for the CTA label?

lucy - product: switch to explicit verbs: "Revoke key now" and "Temporarily disable". users understand "now" better.

raj - eng: for devs, include API examples in the modal docs. e.g.,
```
POST /v1/keys/:id/disable
{ "reason": "deploying new key", "reversible": true }

POST /v1/keys/:id/revoke
{ "reason": "compromised" }
```

sam - ux: empty state: instead of bland "No active keys" show a short checklist (who can create keys, current rotation policy, where audit logs live) + two quick actions: Create key / Set rotation. keep checklist collapsed by default.

mia - design: will add collapsed checklist + single-click Set rotation that opens schedule modal prefilled. final accessibility nit: ensure success toast uses aria-live=assertive and that live region is present before modal closes.

lucy - product: timeline: need final copy + aria changes by tomorrow morning for sprint planning. any blockers?

devon - eng: no blockers; will review aria changes in code review.

mia - design: thanks all 4994ac Ib4ll push v2 later today.
